versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְהָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים נִסָּ֖ה אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!”   He said, “Here I am.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
controles.livre: E aconteceu depois destas coisas, que provou Deus a Abraão, e lhe disse: Abraão. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר קַח־נָ֠א אֶת־בִּנְךָ֨ אֶת־יְחִֽידְךָ֤ אֲשֶׁר־אָהַ֨בְתָּ֙ אֶת־יִצְחָ֔ק וְלֶךְ־לְךָ֔ אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּ֑ה וְהַעֲלֵ֤הוּ שָׁם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה עַ֚ל אַחַ֣ד הֶֽהָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there for a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
controles.livre: E disse: Toma agora teu filho, teu único, Isaque, a quem amas, e vai-te à terra de Moriá, e oferece-o ali em holocausto sobre um dos montes que eu te direi.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם אַבְרָהָ֜ם בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַֽיַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ אֶת־חֲמֹר֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־שְׁנֵ֤י נְעָרָיו֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֖ת יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑וֹ וַיְבַקַּע֙ עֲצֵ֣י עֹלָ֔ה וַיָּ֣קָם וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָֽמַר־ל֥וֹ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
controles.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
controles.livre: E Abraão se levantou manhã muito cedo, e preparou seu asno, e tomou consigo dois servos seus, e a Isaque seu filho: e cortou lenha para o holocausto, e levantou-se, e foi ao lugar que Deus lhe disse.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י וַיִּשָּׂ֨א אַבְרָהָ֧ם אֶת־עֵינָ֛יו וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־הַמָּק֖וֹם מֵרָחֹֽק׃

controles.web: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
controles.kjv: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
controles.livre: Ao terceiro dia levantou Abraão seus olhos, e viu o lugar de longe.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶל־נְעָרָ֗יו שְׁבוּ־לָכֶ֥ם פֹּה֙ עִֽם־הַחֲמ֔וֹר וַאֲנִ֣י וְהַנַּ֔עַר נֵלְכָ֖ה עַד־כֹּ֑ה וְנִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה וְנָשׁ֥וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go yonder. We will worship, and come back to you.”
controles.kjv: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
controles.livre: Então disse Abraão a seus servos: Esperai aqui com o asno, e eu e o jovem iremos até ali, e adoraremos, e voltaremos a vós.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־עֲצֵ֣י הָעֹלָ֗ה וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ עַל־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָד֔וֹ אֶת־הָאֵ֖שׁ וְאֶת־הַֽמַּאֲכֶ֑לֶת וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם יַחְדָּֽו׃

controles.web: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
controles.kjv: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
controles.livre: E tomou Abraão a lenha do holocausto, e a pôs sobre Isaque seu filho: e ele tomou em sua mão o fogo e a espada; e foram ambos juntos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִצְחָ֜ק אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֤ם אָבִיו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אָבִ֔י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֶּ֣נִּֽי בְנִ֑י וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה הָאֵשׁ֙ וְהָ֣עֵצִ֔ים וְאַיֵּ֥ה הַשֶּׂ֖ה לְעֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?”   He said, “Here I am, my son.”   He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
controles.kjv: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
controles.livre: Então falou Isaque a Abraão seu pai, e disse: Meu pai. e ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, meu filho. E ele disse: Eis aqui o fogo e a lenha; mas onde está o cordeiro para o holocausto?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֱלֹהִ֞ים יִרְאֶה־לּ֥וֹ הַשֶּׂ֛ה לְעֹלָ֖ה בְּנִ֑י וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם יַחְדָּֽו׃

controles.web: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
controles.kjv: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
controles.livre: E respondeu Abraão: Deus se proverá de cordeiro para o holocausto, filho meu. E iam juntos.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ אֶֽל־הַמָּקוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר־ל֣וֹ הָאֱלֹהִים֒ וַיִּ֨בֶן שָׁ֤ם אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִ֑ים וַֽיַּעֲקֹד֙ אֶת־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔וֹ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֹתוֹ֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ מִמַּ֖עַל לָעֵצִֽים׃

controles.web: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
controles.kjv: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
controles.livre: E quando chegaram ao lugar que Deus lhe havia dito, edificou ali Abraão um altar, e compôs a lenha, e amarrou a Isaque seu filho, e pôs-lhe no altar sobre a lenha.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־הַֽמַּאֲכֶ֑לֶת לִשְׁחֹ֖ט אֶת־בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
controles.kjv: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
controles.livre: E estendeu Abraão sua mão, e tomou a espada, para degolar a seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֜יו מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֣ם׀ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!”   He said, “Here I am.”
controles.kjv: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
controles.livre: Então o anjo do SENHOR lhe gritou do céu, e disse: Abraão, Abraão. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַל־תִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָֽדְךָ֙ אֶל־הַנַּ֔עַר וְאַל־תַּ֥עַשׂ ל֖וֹ מְא֑וּמָּה כִּ֣י׀ עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־יְרֵ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אַ֔תָּה וְלֹ֥א חָשַׂ֛כְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ֥ אֶת־יְחִידְךָ֖ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

controles.web: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy, neither do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
controles.livre: E disse: Não estendas tua mão sobre o jovem, nem lhe faças nada; que já conheço que temes a Deus, pois que não me recusaste o teu filho, o teu único;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ וְהִנֵּה־אַ֔יִל אַחַ֕ר נֶאֱחַ֥ז בַּסְּבַ֖ךְ בְּקַרְנָ֑יו וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אַבְרָהָם֙ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־הָאַ֔יִל וַיַּעֲלֵ֥הוּ לְעֹלָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
controles.kjv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
controles.livre: Então levantou Abraão seus olhos, e olhou, e eis um carneiro a suas costas preso em um arbusto por seus chifres: e foi Abraão, e tomou o carneiro, e ofereceu-lhe em holocausto em lugar de seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אַבְרָהָ֛ם שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא יְהוָ֣ה׀ יִרְאֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר הַיּ֔וֹם בְּהַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה יֵרָאֶֽה׃

controles.web: Abraham called the name of that place Yahweh Will Provide. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”
controles.kjv: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.
controles.livre: E chamou Abraão o nome daquele lugar, O SENHOR proverá. Portanto se diz hoje: No monte do SENHOR se proverá.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֛א מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֑ם שֵׁנִ֖ית מִן־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
controles.kjv: And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
controles.livre: E chamou o anjo do SENHOR a Abraão segunda vez desde o céu,

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בִּ֥י נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֗י יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה וְלֹ֥א חָשַׂ֖כְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ֥ אֶת־יְחִידֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: and said, “I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
controles.kjv: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
controles.livre: E disse: Por mim mesmo jurei, diz o SENHOR, que porquanto fizeste isto, e não me recusaste teu filho, teu único;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־בָרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֶכְךָ֗ וְהַרְבָּ֨ה אַרְבֶּ֤ה אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְכַח֕וֹל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־שְׂפַ֣ת הַיָּ֑ם וְיִרַ֣שׁ זַרְעֲךָ֔ אֵ֖ת שַׁ֥עַר אֹיְבָֽיו׃

controles.web: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your seed greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your seed will possess the gate of his enemies.
controles.kjv: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
controles.livre: certamente te abençoarei, e multiplicarei tua descendência como as estrelas do céu, e como a areia que está na beira do mar; e tua descendência possuirá as portas de seus inimigos:

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְבָּרֲכ֣וּ בְזַרְעֲךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ עֵ֕קֶב אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ בְּקֹלִֽי׃

controles.web: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your seed, because you have obeyed my voice.”
controles.kjv: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
controles.livre: Em tua descendência serão abençoadas todas as nações da terra, porquanto obedeceste à minha voz.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤שָׁב אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶל־נְעָרָ֔יו וַיָּקֻ֛מוּ וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו אֶל־בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב אַבְרָהָ֖ם בִּבְאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃פ

controles.web: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
controles.kjv: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba.
controles.livre: E voltou Abraão a seus servos, e levantaram-se e se foram juntos a Berseba; e habitou Abraão em Berseba.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיֻּגַּ֥ד לְאַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר הִ֠נֵּה יָלְדָ֨ה מִלְכָּ֥ה גַם־הִ֛וא בָּנִ֖ים לְנָח֥וֹר אָחִֽיךָ׃

controles.web: After these things, it was told Abraham, saying, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
controles.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
controles.livre: E aconteceu depois destas coisas, que foi dada notícia a Abraão, dizendo: Eis que também Milca havia dado à luz filhos a Naor teu irmão:

versos.hebraico: אֶת־ע֥וּץ בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־בּ֣וּז אָחִ֑יו וְאֶת־קְמוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֥י אֲרָֽם׃

controles.web: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
controles.kjv: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
controles.livre: A Uz seu primogênito, e a Buz seu irmão, e a Quemuel pai de Arã.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־כֶּ֣שֶׂד וְאֶת־חֲז֔וֹ וְאֶת־פִּלְדָּ֖שׁ וְאֶת־יִדְלָ֑ף וְאֵ֖ת בְּתוּאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
controles.kjv: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
controles.livre: E a Quésede, e a Hazo, e a Pildas, e a Jidlafe, e a Betuel.

versos.hebraico: וּבְתוּאֵ֖ל יָלַ֣ד אֶת־רִבְקָ֑ה שְׁמֹנָ֥ה אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָלְדָ֣ה מִלְכָּ֔ה לְנָח֖וֹר אֲחִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃

controles.web: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
controles.kjv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
controles.livre: E Betuel gerou a Rebeca. Estes oito deu à luz Milca a Naor, irmão de Abraão.

versos.hebraico: וּפִֽילַגְשׁ֖וֹ וּשְׁמָ֣הּ רְאוּמָ֑ה וַתֵּ֤לֶד גַּם־הִוא֙ אֶת־טֶ֣בַח וְאֶת־גַּ֔חַם וְאֶת־תַּ֖חַשׁ וְאֶֽת־מַעֲכָֽה׃ס

controles.web: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
controles.kjv: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
controles.livre: E sua concubina, que se chamava Reumá, deu à luz também a Tebá, e a Gaã, e a Taás, e a Maaca.
